title: Medicine Nobel awarded for brain ‘switch’ that controls neurons with light
title_zh: 医学诺贝尔奖授予控制神经元光学开关的研究
abstract: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel win the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their work on optogenetics, which has revolutionized neuroscience.
abstract_zh: Karl Deisseroth、Peter Hegemann 和 Georg Nagel 因其在光遗传学方面的工作获得 2026 年生理学或医学诺贝尔奖，该研究彻底改变了神经科学领域。
snippet: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel win the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their work on optogenetics, which has revolutionized neuroscience.
